lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Ordered grid of high-luminance circular pixel clusters arranged in horizontal and vertical rows posterior to the gill slits and extending toward the caudal peduncle.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersecting with horizontal rows of high-luminance blobs to form a distinct grid-like pattern of anchor nodes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal linear ridges visible on the upper flank, displaying high-intensity pixel values on the superior edge and lower-intensity shadow gradients on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Distribution of multiple high-luminance blobs within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, appearing more densely packed and less uniform than the lateral flank grid.
